textbookText: • First of all, contraction of lungs takes place, aided by abdominal muscles. • As a result, lung volume decreases and air pressure in the lung increases. • External nostrils are closed. • Sternohyal muscles contract and volume of buccal cavity increases. • Consequently, air pressure decreases in the buccal cavity and air from lungs moves

to buccal cavity by opening glottis. • Then, contraction of petrohyal muscles takes place. • Volume of buccal cavity decreases and air pressure increases inside it. • Glottis is closed and air moves out by opening nostrils.
